source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper concerns sharp ATE sensitivity bounds under bounded odds-ratio confounding and develops doubly sharp and doubly valid estimation/inference.
The paper treats static or time-varying treatments under three MSM sensitivity models and develops efficient estimators and confidence intervals for causal-parameter bounds.
Ordinary bootstrap consistency for directionally differentiable maps requires full differentiability under a Gaussian limit, and the paper proposes an alternative resampling scheme.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv version corresponding to Annals of Statistics 41, 2786-2819
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Gaussian and conditional Gaussian-multiplier approximations are established for maxima without restrictions on coordinate correlations.

The paper introduces an average-case cross-sectional sensitivity model, derives sharp closed-form bounds and EIF-based estimators, and constructs multiplier-bootstrap simultaneous bands for sensitivity curves.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define explicit simplex maps \(\widetilde F_\pm(z)\) and \(\widetilde f_\beta^\pm(z)\), state their relation to P, and use those maps consistently in the remainder and confidence results.
Add a quantitative strict-gap corollary on observable regions bounded away from every stated threshold surface, giving a lower modulus rather than only one rational witness.

Develop the contact-set construction into a proved adaptive theorem with an explicit screening sequence and a strict-width region; this would turn the generic Fang--Santos template into a stronger independent contribution.

recommended_next_step: Revise the statistical objects to make the seven-cell extension of every endpoint and branch functional explicit, then retain the finite-frontier and equality-atlas kernel as a field-tier proposal.
